blocks.text: Where money sleeps at night. Safe, boring, and absolutely critical.
You sold a house. You have ₹1 Crore. You need it in 6 months to buy a new house. Where do you put it?

3% Interest. You lose money to inflation.
✅ Money Market?
7% Interest. Almost zero risk. Highly liquid.
blocks.title: ❌ Savings Account?

blocks.text: This market is where Banks, Governments, and Giants borrow cash for 1 to 364 days.

items: T-Bills (Treasury Bills): You lend to the Govt of India for 91, 182, or 364 days. Risk: ZERO.
CP (Commercial Paper): You lend to Reliance/Tata for 3 months. Risk: Low.
CD (Certificate of Deposit): You lend to HDFC Bank for 1 year. Risk: Low.

blocks.text: A Mutual Fund that only buys 91-day bonds. The graph is a straight line going up.
Some Liquid Funds allow you to withdraw ₹50,000 instantly (24x7) to your bank account. It works exactly like a Savings Account but pays double the interest.

The Tax Hack: Liquid Funds are taxed at your slab rate (30% for high earners). Arbitrage Funds are taxed as Equity (12.5% after 1 year).
Strategy: Use Arbitrage Funds for parking cash > 6 months. It returns 7-8% risk-free but saves you massive tax compared to FDs.
blocks.title: ☠️ GOD MODE: Arbitrage Funds
